claim: Rich paste replacing part of inline-link text must not accidentally expand link ownership to surrounding pasted content.
verification: `inlines.test.ts` covers paste outside link boundaries and plain paste inside a link; P101 full touched-file browser proof passed.

claim: Native input islands inside decorators must keep copy/paste local and not route repeated paste through the parent editor.
decision: Keep existing editable-void native input proof.
verification: `editable-voids.test.ts` keeps native paste inside the input and P101 passed the full touched file.

claim: Rich HTML pasted into a nested child editor should preserve marks when that child root owns rich HTML parsing.
decision: Defer to paste API/design owner; current editable-void route does not own the paste-html deserializer, and a reverted experiment proved text insertion without strong mark preservation.
verification: Failed/reverted focused Playwright experiment across Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit.

claim: Pasted ProseMirror slice metadata should guide parsing or be stripped from user-visible content.
verification: `paste-html.test.ts` covers ProseMirror list, text, and table row slices without exposing metadata.

claim: Table copy/paste needs rectangular cell-area normalization, clipping, padding, and repeat semantics.
decision: Supporting-only in this paste artifact; the active owner is `docs/slate-v2/research/2026-06-13-table-clipboard-web-scout/lead-ledger.tsv` plus `docs/slate-v2/table-fragment-semantics.md`, not generic rich HTML paste.
verification: Table-fragment contract owns rectangle algebra; current browser proof covers table row slice import and pagination table copy.

claim: Paste transform chains can express sanitizer, whitespace, and extension-owned HTML normalization policy.
decision: Closed by current Slate API shape: extension-owned `clipboard.insertData` is the transform point; no separate public transform-chain API is accepted.
verification: Focused extension contract and paste-html sanitizer/whitespace rows passed in active slate-auto run.

claim: Pasting a URL over selected text can create a link in link-plugin products.
decision: Reject for Slate core; route only to product/plugin owner if requested.
